Definition
[Hamiltonian associated with a Lagrangian] 1. ch3:3.3.1-def-1\group Calculus of Variations The Hamiltonian associated with $L$ is \[ H(p,x)=p\cdot \mathbf q(p,x)-L(\mathbf q(p,x),x). \]
